data_set.title: Processed Near-bottom Bathymetry Scanning Sonar Images (PDF format) from the East Pacific Rise at 9N acquired during the Atlantis expedition AT11-10 (2004)
data_set.description: This data set was acquired with a Imagenex 881 Scanning Sonar on the HOV Alvin during Atlantis expedition AT11-10 conducted in 2004 (Chief Scientist: Dr. Richard Lutz; Investigator(s): Dr. Vicki Ferrini). These data files are of PDF format and include Bathymetry images and were processed after data collection. Data were acquired as part of the project(s): Integrated Studies of Biological Community Structure at Deep-Sea Hydrothermal Vents (PIRATES-II), Seismic Monitoring of the 9N East Pacific Rise, and Student Experiments at Sea (SEAS), and funding was provided by NSF grant(s): OCE03-26434, OCE03-27261, OCE03-27283, and OCE03-27353.

data_set.title: Processed Near-bottom Bathymetry Data (ASCII format) derived from Scanning Altimetric Sonar Data from the East Pacific Rise at 9N acquired with HOV Alvin during the Atlantis expedition AT11-20 (2004)
data_set.description: This data set was acquired with an Imagenex 881 Scanning Sonar on the HOV Alvin during Atlantis expedition AT11-20 conducted in 2004 (Chief Scientist: Dr. Marvin Lilley). These data files are of Text (ASCII) format and include Bathymetry data that were merged with navigation and processed after data acquisition. Data were acquired as part of the project(s): Biocomplexity: Smart Sensors for In Situ Monitoring of Hydrothermal Vent Systems, Establishing a Role for Fe and S Microbial Metabolism in Ocean Crust Weathering, Time-Series Larval Studies in the Deep Sea, and The Interaction of Microbial Biofilms and Fluid Chemistry on Larval Settlement, and funding was provided by NSF grant(s): OCE01-19999, OCE02-41791, and DOEI.

data_set.title: DSV Alvin composite scanning sonar bathymetry grids from East Pacific Rise (EPR) 9°50N
data_set.description: This data set includes 0.5 m resolution gridded bathymetry data that were acquired with an Imagenex 881 Scanning Sonar on the HOV Alvin during multiple dives and expeditions. Data were acquired in 2004: AT-11-07, AT-11-10, AT-11-13, AT-11-20 and 2005: AT-11-26. Data were assembled and integrated as part of the 2006 EPR_9N_Ferrini data compilation (Lead Scientist: Dr. Vicki Ferrini). This data set includes gridded bathymetry data files are of NetCDF Grid format and MATLAB binary files that contain XYZ points as well as gridded data. These data were described by Ferrini et al., 2007.

data_set.title: Processed Near-bottom Bathymetry Data (ASCII format) derived from Scanning Altimetric Sonar Data from the East Pacific Rise at 9N acquired with HOV Alvin during Atlantis expedition AT11-10 (2004)
data_set.description: This data set was acquired with an Imagenex 881 Scanning Sonar on the HOV Alvin during Atlantis expedition AT11-10 conducted in 2004 (Chief Scientist: Dr. Richard Lutz; Investigator(s): Dr. Richard Lutz and Dr. Vicki Ferrini). These data files are of Text (ASCII) format and include Bathymetry data that were merged with navigation and processed after data acquisition. Data were acquired as part of the project(s): Integrated Studies of Biological Community Structure at Deep-Sea Hydrothermal Vents (PIRATES-II), Seismic Monitoring of the 9N East Pacific Rise, and Student Experiments at Sea (SEAS), and funding was provided by NSF grant(s): OCE03-26434, OCE03-27261, OCE03-27283, and OCE03-27353.

data_set.title: Processed Near-bottom Bathymetry Data (ASCII format) derived from Scanning Altimetric Sonar Data from the East Pacific Rise at 9N acquired with HOV Alvin during Atlantis expedition AT15-14 (2006)
data_set.description: This data set was acquired with an Imagenex 881 Scanning Sonar on the HOV Alvin during Atlantis expedition AT15-14 conducted in 2006 (Chief Scientist: Dr. James Ledwell). These data files are of Text (ASCII) format and include Bathymetry data that were merged with navigation and processed after data acquisition. Data were acquired as part of the project(s): Larval Dispersal Along the Deep East Pacific Rise (LADDER-2), Collaborative Research: Oceanographic and Topographic Influences on Dispersal of Hydrothermal Vent Species, Development and colonization processes in Alvinella pompejana, Hydrothermal Vent Meiobenthos, Potential of hydrothermal plumes as a source of dissolved iron (Fe) to the deep ocean and a sink of dissolved organic carbon (DOC), Chemical Characterizations of Vent Habitats, Development, Growth and Cell Kinetic Studies in Riftia Pachyptila, and Preliminary Deployment of Magnetic Collectors for Examination of Vent Particle Dispersal, and funding was provided by NSF grant(s): OCE04-24953.

Data were acquired as part of the project(s): Collaborative Research: Integrated Studies of Biological Community Structure at Deep-Sea Hydrothermal Vents, IDEA: Coupling Communication Technology with in Situ Voltammetric Analyzers for Real Time and Unattended Monitoring of Biogeochemically Relevant Chemical Species, and Collaborative Research: MIP: Physiology and molecular ecology of thermophilic nitrate-reducing microorgansisms at deep-sea hydrothermal vents, and funding was provided by NSF grant(s): MCB04-56676, OCE03-08398, and OCE03-27353.
